Junior Software Engineer (Python / Backend)
Paytm
Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India (On-site)

About Paytm:
Paytm is India's payment super app offering comprehensive payment and financial services.

Job Description:
We are hiring fresh engineering graduates for our core backend engineering team.

Responsibilities:
• Design and build RESTful APIs and microservices in Python and Flask/Django.
• Write clean, testable code and adhere to data structures and algorithms best practices.
• Manage PostgreSQL and Redis database schemas, queries, and migrations.
• Participate in code reviews, CI/CD pipeline automation, and Agile sprints using Git.

Requirements:
• 0-1 years of experience or fresh graduates with strong project portfolio.
• Strong command over Python, SQL, data structures, algorithms, and Git.
• B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT, or related technical disciplines.
• Passion for building scalable web applications.
